name: ravicom-mail
description: Connect your own Yandex Mail account to ChatGPT for safe mailbox search and organization.

interface.longDescription: Подключите свой ящик Яндекс.Почты для поиска, чтения, создания папок и организации писем. RAVICOM Mail не отправляет письма и не удаляет их безвозвратно.
defaultPrompt: Создай папку «Работа» и перемести туда выбранные письма.
Найди непрочитанные письма за эту неделю.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the user's Yandex Mail folders without changing messages.
Returns folder counts and mailbox totals from the connected account.

positive.prompt: Find unread messages from this week.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching unread messages with stable identifiers and subjects.

positive.prompt: Open the first matching message and summarize it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads only the selected message and provides a concise summary.

positive.prompt: Preview old read messages in my inbox.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a reviewable candidate list and does not move anything.

negative.prompt: Send an email to test@example.com saying hello.
Permanently delete all messages in my inbox.
Move every message in my inbox to Trash without asking me to confirm.
